content: GitHub Dependabot alerts REST API (/repos/{owner}/{repo}/dependabot/alerts) exposes state incl. dismissed, with dismissal reasons fix_started/inaccurate/no_bandwidth/not_used/tolerable_risk. Dependabot auto-triage rules can auto-dismiss/reopen by severity/package/CWE metadata. This is a GitHub-platform-coupled alternative to an in-repo audit tool; viable as a supplementary signal but not a drop-in CI-gate replacement for a portable npm-workspaces audit script.
